scope: Read existing generator arithmetic, confirmation guidance CSV, and four selected already-written step logs plus one audit; no quality metric files, full trajectory scan, models, or scientific reevaluation.

readout_origin.finding: shadow_terminal_corner_rms is computed from the original terminal internal state final[:K]-c. _final_arrays copies final before replacing raw C. shadow_terminal.npz stores final, not the restored export. Therefore this error is not computed from the final exact C restoration.

formula_review.energy: sum((X+(1-t)*v_CFG)[:K]-C)^2/(2*omega2), without detaching v before input VJP
formula_review.correction: -h*lambda*(1-t)/t*gradient; one full-state maximum-corner scalar cap; G2 masks F only after shared cap; G3 retains full correction
formula_review.finding: Source and sampled logs are consistent with the registered input VJP and mask; no missing free cross-gradient is indicated.

interpretation: The measured improvement of shadow alignment is very small under this fixed corner-correspondence representation and globally capped recipe.
This check does not establish that clipping is the sole cause of weak alignment, or that alternate representations or recipes must fail.

When the global cap is saturated, positive scalar factors common to the whole gradient are normalized away; simply increasing lambda does not necessarily increase the applied correction. The normalized direction and largest-gradient corner matter.
Fixed-correspondence shadow RMS is not by itself a physical surface-quality or adoption judgment; visual reviews remain independent.

new_computation.activity: Existing CSV arithmetic, reading selected existing JSON logs, and hashing the listed small files only.
